section_summary.extract_value: This section details Study 2, which aimed to replicate previous findings within the Harvard population, focusing on the relationship between Latent Inhibition (LI) and lifetime creative achievement. The study concentrated on individual difference scores within a preexposed condition and utilized the CAQ (Creativity Achievement Questionnaire) to measure creative achievement. Additionally, the Marlowe-Crowne Social Desirability Scale (MCSD) was administered to control for self-enhancement bias in participant responses.
